contexts.text: To distinguish them they have a kind of circle with brass points... SE 1280.
Such is the circle of things with men. AC 4247:2.
WE 970. SE 757, Explained.
The radiant circle is the Divine from Him.
The circle by what communications take place.
The Lord seen encompassed with a solar circle.
The light which is the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord was described by radiant circles... DLW 94.
Such is the circle of things from the world through the natural man into his spiritual man, and from this again into the world. Explained.
As this circle is the circle of man's life...
This Divine sphere was likened to radiant circles...
Such a circle of the love to the thoughts and from the thoughts to the love from the love is in all things of the human mind; which circle may be called the circle of life. See SE 757.
Comparison with squaring the circle.
The mind is thus circumscribed as in a circle...
Such a man appears from Heaven... with a yellow circle round the head; such a one... with a white circle. The circles round the head represent intelligence. Explained.
A devil seen rising up with a lucid white circle round his head...
The Sun is the nearest circle...
This is called the circle of things...
Forms which far surpass the circle and the curves which relate to the circle.
The circle of man's life is to know, to understand, to will, and to do...
Jehovah Who dwells upon the circle of the earth () = that the Lord as to intelligence is in the highest things.
To dwell upon the circle of the earth = upon Heaven, for Heaven encompasses the earth as a circle does its centre.
All love returns as by a circle to that from which it came.
Angelic Idea of Creation. The Divine which proceeds was effigied by golden or lucid circles round the head of God.
